scope: Toss-compatible Kiwoom multi-broker implementation; local synthetic broker contracts and regression tests

safety.backend_isolation: Credentials cleared, dotenv loading disabled, external TCP rejected in the test process; local loopback permitted. Spawn/IPC tests use fake managers.
safety.browser_isolation: Empty temporary worktree dotenv, broker credentials cleared, HTTP/WS broker responses stubbed.

coverage: Opaque stable account identities, environment separation, credential rebinding and cross-account rejection
Explicit order remainder, native leading zeros and business-day identity, cash-only capacities and duplicate holding rows
New orders, modify/cancel lineage and route retention, frozen bulk-cancel targets
Durable deduplication, restart, canceled waiters, queue expiry, lost/invalid acknowledgements and post-send local failures
Private account events, monotonic remainder checks, queue overflow retirement, shared WS owner and reliable collector IPC
Legacy Toss and v2 command joining, event conversion isolation, broker switching and disabled Kiwoom routes
Drag geometry stability, existing click/drag/cancel, high-value confirmation, account panels and order settings
limits: No authenticated Kiwoom server order acceptance, fill, replace or cancel was exercised.
Official contract examples and synthetic events do not establish real exchange semantics or rate-limit boundaries.
Kiwoom routes remain disabled until operator acceptance evidence is recorded for the exact account, environment and route.
The earlier 26 production read-only probes belong to the design-stage report and were not repeated here.
